label: Some model satisfies jointly: the concrete/abstract anchors, the owner's #1113 bridge, N1 in all…
meaning: A model with the spacetime whole, its stages part n (each caused by part (n+1)) and a non-existent number two: every existent is located in the one region, related to every existent and a part of the whole; nothing causes the whole, and the stages form the injective regress n ↦ part n. It satisfies every conjunct of the survivor statement, so the brute-universe and regress escapes are consistent with N1–N3i and with every listed floor item.
